given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator initiates an amendment to an active Store Partner Agreement
given_when_then.when: The system processes the amendment request
given_when_then.then: A new version of the agreement is created with updated terms, and the previous version is archived as historical data.

given_when_then.given: An active Store Partner Agreement is amended
given_when_then.when: The system processes the amendment request
given_when_then.then: A new version number is assigned to the agreement and the previous version is marked as historical.

success_criteria: The system creates a new version of the agreement immediately upon any amendment.
The previous version of the agreement is retained in the history and marked as historical.
The system prevents the deletion of any agreement version once it has been created.
